old: A 1987 500 lire from Italy. The obverse shows female head of Italia; the reverse shows Quirinale Palazzo; Dioscuri, L. 500, Braille 500 on ring, wheat, date, R. Struck in bimetallic (bronzesital center with an acmonital ring).
new: A 1987 500 lire from Italy. The obverse shows female head of Italia; the reverse shows Quirinale Palazzo; Dioscuri, L. 500, Braille 500 on ring, wheat, date, R. Struck in bimetallic (bronzital center with an acmonital ring).
source: Numista N#302 (https://en.numista.com/catalogue/pieces302.html): Italy 500 lire 1982-2001 (KM# 111, Schön# 110): composition 'Bimetallic: bronzital centre in acmonital ring'; reverse 'a view of the Piazza del Quirinale, Rome, with small date in lower position. Value ("L.500") in Braille at top of the outer ring, as text at the bottom; plants on either sides' (lettering R 1987 L.500); obverse female head (Laura Cretara). The story misspelled the centre alloy as 'bronzesital'; the alloy is bronzital. Only that word was changed; the rest of the story matches the entry.
